title: Drifter Bar Salts Watermelon Apple 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Watermelon Apple by Drifter Bar Salts delivers a refreshingly crisp and juicy vape. The delicate sweetness of fresh Watermelon is balanced by the bright, crisp bite of Green Apple, creating a mouth-watering fruit blend that’s both uplifting and satisfyingly smooth. This nic salt e-liquid is crafted with a 50% PG / 50% VG blend, offering a smooth throat hit, rapid nicotine relief, and discreet vapour production. Available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, it’s ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) and RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) vaping styles, especially when paired with low-powered pod kits and starter devices. Drifter Bar Salts are designed to capture the punchy, mouth-watering flavours of disposable vapes in a reusable e-liquid format, helping you enjoy your favourite blends while saving money and reducing waste. Why not try other incredible flavours from Drifter's Bar Salts and Bar Juice collections? From Lime Raspberry Cherry to Strawberry Raspberry Cherry, to Blueberry and Cherry and Blackcurrant Ice, whatever your taste in e-liquid, Drifter E-liquid has an incredible flavour waiting to light up your tastebuds.
